# Neon Horizon (`synthGrid`)

An endless neon grid racing toward a striped sunset over glowing ridges.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: medium (~6.0 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Neon Horizon, Night Drive

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 3 | 1 |
| `grid` | Grid Density | slider | 0.5 … 2.5 | 1 |
| `mountains` | Mountains | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 1 |
| `sun` | Sun Size | slider | 0.5 … 1.5 | 1 |
| `haze` | Haze | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 0.8 |
| `stars` | Stars | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.7 |
